Election Information

November 3, 2026, Gubernatorial General Election

Under the California Voter’s Choice Act, every active registered voter in San Diego County will receive a ballot in the mail.

Confirm you're registered to vote.

If anything has changed, complete a new voter registration online.

Your Voting Options

Vote by Mail

All active registered voters will receive a ballot by mail the week of October 5.

You can fill out your ballot at home at your convenience. After marking your selections:

  • Sign and date your return envelope
  • Seal your completed ballot inside
  • Return your ballot in one of the following ways:

Mail It:

Return your ballot promptly through the U.S. Postal Service. Must be postmarked no later than Tuesday, November 3.

Drop It:

Starting Sunday, October 4, until 8 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, drop off your ballot at any of the Registrar’s official ballot drop boxes located throughout the county.

Vote In Person

Visit:

If you prefer to visit a vote center, you can bring your mail ballot or vote on a Ballot Marking Device. You have several opportunities during the early voting period to cast your ballot:

  • Starting Saturday, October 24:
    • Vote early! Select vote centers will be open daily from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
  • Starting Saturday, October 31:
    • Vote early! All vote centers will be open daily from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
  • Election Day – Tuesday, November 3:
    • Last day to vote! All vote centers, official ballot drop boxes, and the Registrar’s office will be open from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m.
